soldier: The soldier has the head brown, the front of the frons brown, anteclypeus and labrum pale brown, mandibles blackish brown, antennae yellow, eye spots pale, postmentum the same colour as the head with the lateral margins dark brown; pronotum paler than the head but distinctly darker than the yellow abdomen, the tergite of the last abdominal segment brown; body hairs fine, short and sparse. Head rectangular, the lateral margins almost parallel, slightly broader near the posterior margin, the posterior margin arcuate; at the junction of the frons and the vertex two separate mound-like projections project forwards, the frontal surface sloping at about 60 degrees. Labrum narrow and long, its length exactly reaching the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible, its tip narrow and rounded, the sides slightly converging towards the tip. Antennae with 11 segments, the third shortest. Mandibles short, their tips slightly curved inwards, the left mandible with four marginal teeth, the right with three, of which the third is very weak, like only a small projection. Pronotum as wide as the head or slightly narrower, flat and square, the sides oblique and nearly parallel, the anterior margin deeply concave in an arc with almost no median notch, the posterior margin arcuate with a median notch. The hind femur swollen, more than half as wide as long.
